name: dojo-gates
description: Deterministic guards for the mistakes that waste a day: blanket staging, rewriting pushed commits, printing secrets, oversized reads, silent probes.

claude_md_reach.title: CLAUDE.md reach guard
claude_md_reach.description: Off by default. When on, the first edit under a directory whose nearest CLAUDE.md was never loaded this session is denied once, naming the file to read.
